subject.title: feat: let a clerk mark stock status and hide out-of-stock products

question: Which supported storage primitive should make the combined price and stock-status update safe against concurrent saves?
rationale: The current storage interfaces expose independent record writes, so choosing transaction support versus a versioned compatibility protocol requires repository ownership judgment.

options.title: Use an atomic mutation boundary
options.body: Perform the price and manual-availability changes in one supported transaction or command so either both persist or neither does.

options.title: Adopt versioned compensation
options.body: Add a price revision and restore only when the failed request still owns the stored price version.

recommendation.title: Use an atomic mutation boundary
recommendation.body: Perform the price and manual-availability changes in one supported transaction or command so either both persist or neither does.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available adjacent owner for the related Manage Stock state work and this PR's save-path design.
